title: Father's racehorse fixing overheard as a child
place_text: Lazar family home (Long Island, New York)

tellings.quote: playing in the living room and hearing those guys deciding who's going to win the race

plain: In the early 1970s, as a boy at the family home on Long Island, Bob Lazar says he overheard his father and other men fixing horse races. Lazar tells Michels he remembers 'playing in the living room and hearing those guys deciding who's going to win the race', a glimpse of the world he grew up in.
